meanings.en: to kick out, to drive out
meanings.note: Expel someone from a place. Prefix 'вы-' ('out of') marks outward movement or thorough completion (stem 'гнать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to kick out, to evict, to drive out', paired with 'выгонять'.
